stemMd:
The town's first map showed only roads and property boundaries. A later edition added wells and public pumps. ______, a third edition included drainage channels, allowing readers to see more of the water system.

Which choice best completes the text?
explanationMd: The passage traces successive editions. Subsequently places the third addition later in that sequence without suggesting contradiction or mere paraphrase.

distractorRationale.b: The third edition extends a sequence rather than reversing a relationship.
distractorRationale.a: There is no obstacle that the third edition overcomes despite the previous one.
distractorRationale.c: The third edition is a new event, not a restatement.
